title: Myeloid Piezo1 Drives Cardiac Repair Through Orai1-Rac1-Dependent Efferocytosis.
text: Monocytes/macrophages orchestrate myocardial remodeling through efferocytosis, the calcium-dependent clearance of apoptotic cells. While the mechanosensitive channel Piezo1 is known to modulate calcium influx in cardiac and immune contexts, its myeloid-specific role in postinfarction healing remains elusive.
